ImageParts collection returns wrong length and incorrect image parts

Description

When working with image parts in a document package, the ImageParts collection is returning an incorrect length (one less than expected) and the get_or_add_image_part method is behaving unexpectedly when matching existing images.

Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document
from docx.package import Package

# Open a document with images
package = Package.open('document_with_images.docx')
image_parts = package.image_parts

# Check the length - this returns one less than expected
print(f"Image parts length: {len(image_parts)}")  # Shows 2 instead of 3

# Try to get or add an existing image
image_part = image_parts.get_or_add_image_part('existing_image.jpg')
# This creates a new image part instead of returning the existing one
```

The issue manifests in two ways:
1. The `len()` method on ImageParts returns a count that's off by one
2. When trying to get an existing image part, it creates a new one instead of returning the matching existing part
</issue>
